q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F2.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 INNER JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT F2.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 INNER JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee who is also a follower of someone else, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each followee.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when there are multiple followers for the same followee, and the followee is also a follower of another user.
